scope: we establish the first interactomes of FOSL1 and FOSL2 in human Th17 cells, using affinity purification–mass spectrometry analysis
In the present study, we co-immunoprecipitated putative interactors of FOSL1 and FOSL2 in human Th17 cells and identified them by liquid chromatography with tandem MS (LC-MS/MS)
The IP eluates for control IgG, FOSL1, and FOSL2 were denatured with urea buffer (8 M urea, 50 mM Tris-HCl, and pH 8.0), followed by reduction using dithiothreitol (10 mM) at 37 °C for 1 h.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on material affinity-purified via immunoprecipitation of FOSL1 and FOSL2. While the text mentions cellular fractionation (nuclear/cytoplasmic) for Western Blotting validation, the material actually analyzed by LC-MS/MS was the IP eluate.
